description: This file contains utility functions and types related to cluster connectivity and member status in the etcd server, including connection checks, longest active member selection, and a panic-safe stringer wrapper.

classes.name: notifier
classes.description: A synchronization primitive with a channel and error state, used for notification purposes.

classes.name: panicAlternativeStringer
classes.description: A wrapper around fmt.Stringer that safely handles panics in String() calls by providing an alternative string.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sets the error and closes the notification channel to signal an event.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the wrapped Stringer, or the alternative if a panic occurs.
